newsitem.title: USA: Temple Q1 hurt by low container prices.
newsitem.headline: Temple Q1 hurt by low container prices.

text.p: Temple-Inland Inc on Monday said first quarter results were hurt by declining prices in the paper group's corrugated container operation.
Prices declined for both for containerboard and corrugated containers throughout the first quarter.
The company noted that demand for corrugated containers strengthened in the quarter and shipments were up about five percent over first quarter 1996 levels.
Earlier, the firm reported that first quarter 1997 net income was $13.2 million, or $0.24 per share, off from first quarter 1996 net income of $46.4 million, or $0.84 per share.
Temple's paper group recorded an operating loss of $7.1 million in the first quarter, down from operating earnings of $61.2 million in the first quarter of 1996.
The bleached paperboard operation experienced improved sales and production volumes throughout the quarter after encountering problems with a digester early in the quarter.
Temple's building products group reported first quarter operating earnings of $32.1 million, up from $17 million one year ago.
After slumping late in the fourth quarter, demand for lumber, particleboard and fiberboard strengthened during the first quarter, Temple said.
